pages.text: The stations pass the structure checks. Insert a charged cell on the initiating side and select Energize.
pages.title: All Systems Operational

pages.text: Craft two unlinked computers with one Essence of Entanglement between them. Replace the installed computers with the resulting pair.
pages.title: No Frequency Detected

pages.text: Check that the paired computer is placed in the same dimension. Compare the Frequency tooltips before placing the pair.
pages.title: Counterpart Not Found

pages.text: Open the other computer and read its own status. Correct its pylon setup or other reported problem before trying again.
pages.title: Counterpart Is Errored

pages.text: Put a properly configured Observer-Dependent base on each cardinal arm at computer level, one to eight blocks away. Gold faces inward and Obsidian fills the other five faces.
pages.title: Incomplete Pylon System

pages.text: Check all four pylons at the station reporting this error. Make them equally tall with uninterrupted Obsidian directly above each base.
pages.title: Misaligned Pylon Heights

pages.text: Compare north with north, east with east, south with south, and west with west. Match the base distance on every arm at both stations.
pages.title: Pylon Distances Differ

pages.text: Both stations need the same pylon height. Count each base as the first block and match the number of Obsidian blocks above it.
pages.title: Pylon Heights Differ

pages.text: Bring both stations and every chunk touched by the swap into loaded range. Reduce the distance or keep a second player nearby.
pages.title: Station or Region Unloaded

pages.text: Rebuild within the world border and build height. Check the full interior and its top layer, including any corners that extend past the border.
pages.title: Region Outside World Bounds

pages.text: Move one station farther away. The two complete interior footprints need to be separate.
pages.title: The Regions Overlap

pages.text: For ‘A region contains a qBlock or block entity’, remove all qBlocks and blocks such as chests, furnaces, hoppers, or extra computers from both interiors.
pages.title: Unsupported Cargo

pages.text: Put charged coolant in the initiating computer. $(l:qcraft:computers/coolant)Refill a used cell$(/l) with Blue Ice when needed.
pages.title: Insert a Charged Cell

pages.text: The block exchange did not finish. Check both regions and retry with a small test area of ordinary solid blocks. If it recurs, share the server log and station layout with the operator.
pages.title: The Region Swap Failed
